prompt:
Rebuild a clean flat-front football jersey (01 product style). Transparent RGBA PNG with true alpha. No mannequin, no soft 3D, no logos/text/numbers/crests/watermarks.

IMAGE 1 = GEOMETRY MASTER (kit 18 full front). Copy ONLY silhouette, torso length, raglan short sleeves, and CREW COLLAR CONSTRUCTION: solid continuous single-color thick rib crew, clear circular opening, thick separate rib piece, gray inner/back-of-collar cue, cuff/hem proportions. Do NOT keep IMAGE 1 charcoal/yellow geo paint. Do NOT keep IMAGE 1 yellow collar paint.

IMAGE 2 = COLLAR GEOMETRY CLOSE-UP (crew-18-collar). Reinforce collar shape only: solid rib band, circular hole, thickness like Unichant class-A crew. Ignore any colors in IMAGE 2.

IMAGE 3 = GEOMETRY REINFORCE (kit 22 approved on-18 front). Shape only — same solid-rib crew construction as IMAGE 1. Ignore IMAGE 3 white/pink paint entirely.

IMAGE 4 = PAINT MASTER (kit 23 body hoops). Copy ONLY body + sleeve paint: alternating horizontal yellow and navy/royal blue HOOPS across torso and sleeves. DISCARD IMAGE 4 collar entirely (wrong white V or any tipped collar).

IMAGE 5 = design sheet for collar COLOR only. Collar band = SOLID NAVY (same navy as the dark hoop stripes). No yellow tip, no yellow stripe through the rib face, no piping across the collar band. Use IMAGE 5 only for solid navy collar color + hoop color check. Do NOT copy logos, numbers, shorts, typography, or sheet layout.

CRITICAL COLLAR RULES (must all be true):
1) Construction = Unichant class-A solid continuous rib CREW like kit 18/21/22 — NOT tipped soccer collar, NOT V-neck, NOT V-wrap, NOT yellow stripe across band.
2) Collar band paint = SOLID NAVY only (matches dark hoop navy). FORBIDDEN: yellow tip/stripe on collar face, white collar, kit 11 white rib, kit 18 yellow collar.
3) Gray inner/back-of-collar cue like kit 18.
4) Body/sleeves = yellow/navy horizontal hoops from IMAGE 4. Clean chest. Transparent flat front only.
